To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we designed and synthesized a series of 2-aroyloxazolo[5,4-f][1,8]phenanthroine ligands (N ^ N) and their cations iridium (III) complexes.
we synthesized a series of 2-aroyloxazolo[5,4-f][1, 10]phenanthrolines, which are used as ligands in the cationic iridiun(III) complexes.
the 2-aryl-substituents at the oxazole ring of the 2-(2-aryl-oxazolo[4',5':4,5]phenanthro-line) (N^N)-ligated cationic Ir complexes significantly affect their photophysical properties.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a series of 2-substituted oxazolo[1,10] phenanthroline ligated Ir(III) cationic complexes.
a new class of cationic ir(III) complexes bearing a 2-aryl substituted oxazolo[5,4-f][1,9]phenanthroine ligand.
the synthesis, crystal structure, photophysics, mechanochromic/vapochromic effects, and reverse saturable absorption of a series of 2-substituted oxazolo[1,10]biphenanthroline cationic Ir complexes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the photophysical properties of cationic iridiium(III) complex are highly tunable through the introduction of different substituents on oxazolo [4,5-f] [1,10] phenanthroline ligans.

the 4-R-substituted complexes 1-5 with R = NO2, Br, Ph, NPh2, or NH2, and the 2-naphthalenyl-substituted complex 8 exhibited weak to moderate photophysical properties, while the complexes 6-10 bearing polycyclic arly substituents with π-conjugated systems showed moderate to very strong photophysical and RSA properties.

the introduction of electron-donating groups on the phenyl ring (N^N = 4-R-2-aryl-5-oxazolo[4′,5′:f]phenanthrolinato) or the π-conjugation of the 2-aromatic substituent (N^N-2 = 4-R′-2-aryl) can enhance the singlet and/or triplet excited-state absorption, which in turn enhances the RSA of the complexes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the photophysical and photodynamic properties of the cationic ir(III) complexes can be tuned by the 2-aryl substitution on the oxazole motif of the oxazolo-[4,5-f]-[1,10] phenanthroline ligant, and the photophysical and optical properties of these complexes are highly dependent on the nature of the 2-aroyl substituents.

the 4-Br, 4-NO _{2} and 4-Ph substituents at oxazolo[ 4, 5 - f ][ 1, 10 ]phenanthroline ring would lead to a more coplanar structure and a higher degree of electron delocalization, which in turn results in a lower triplet excited-state energy level.
the 2-aryloxoazolophenanthroline motif is an effective ligand platform for designing cationic irridium(III)-based materials with tunable optical properties.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the 2-aryl ring substituent on oxazole ring of N^N ligand can be used as a versatile tool for fine-tuning the photophysical properties of cationic ir(III) complexes.
the 2-aryl substitution on the oxazolo ring of N^N ligand can be used as a facile and effective strategy to modulate the photophysical properties of Ir(III) N^N complexes.

the 2-aryl-substituted oxazolo[1,10]biphenanthroline motif is a versatile scaffold to construct cationic Ir complexes that exhibit a wide range of optical properties, which may be useful for applications in organic electronics, sensing, and nonlinear optics.
